vocabulary.meaning_en: adverb: exclusive, no more than; adjective: the one, the single (the only choice)
vocabulary.example: This is the only time you can come.

vocabulary.meaning_en: no more than; exactly; very recently; barely; really
vocabulary.example: I had just missed the bus.

vocabulary.meaning_en: limited to one person or group; keeping others out

vocabulary.example: The rule excludes people without tickets.

vocabulary.meaning_en: completely correct; no more, no less
vocabulary.example: This holiday is just (exactly) what I need.

vocabulary.meaning_en: almost not; only by a small amount
vocabulary.example: I have just enough money – I barely have enough.
That's just silly. = That's absolutely silly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a limit; something that stops more

vocabulary.example: It was the only choice she could make.
You are the only person allowed here.

vocabulary.meaning_en: that you can get or use
vocabulary.example: There are only five tickets available.

vocabulary.meaning_en: just in time, at the last moment
vocabulary.example: We got to the station in the nick of time.

fine_lines.title: only = just (same meaning, about 60%)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كظرف بمعنى "لا أكثر من" يمكن استعمال الكلمتين: It's only five dollars = It's just five dollars. We only have two tickets = We just have two tickets.
fine_lines.explanation_en: As adverbs meaning "no more than", both work: It's only five dollars = It's just five dollars.

fine_lines.title: just (not only): exactly / very recently
fine_lines.explanation_ar: just بمعنى "تمامًا" (just what I need) أو "للتوّ" (I had just missed the bus) لا يمكن استبدالها بـ only.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Just" meaning "exactly" (just what I need) or "very recently" (I had just missed the bus) can't be replaced by "only".

examples.sentence: This vacation is just what I need.

fine_lines.title: only (not just): the one / the only choice
fine_lines.explanation_ar: only كصفة قبل اسم (the only person, the only choice) تعني الوحيد، ولا يمكن قول the just.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Only" as an adjective before a noun (the only person, the only choice) means the one; you can't say "the just".

examples.sentence: You are the only person allowed here.
✗ You are the just person allowed here.

expressions.example: That glass of water was just what I needed.
I have just enough money for the bus.
The bridge is closed. Taking the boat is the only choice.

expressions.phrase: only the beginning / just the beginning
expressions.meaning_en: there is much more to come
expressions.example: This lesson is only the beginning.

grammar.title: Adverb: only/just = no more than (similar)
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما يكون المعنى "لا أكثر من" أو "حصريًا" يمكن استعمال only أو just.
grammar.explanation_en: When the meaning is "no more than" or "exclusive", you can use either only or just.
examples: We only have two tickets left.
There are just/only five tickets available.

grammar.title: just = exactly / very recently (adverb)
grammar.explanation_ar: just تعني بالضبط (just what I need)، أو حدث قبل قليل (I had just missed the bus). هنا لا تصلح only.
grammar.explanation_en: "Just" means exactly (just what I need) or a very short time ago (I had just missed the bus). "Only" doesn't work here.
examples: This is just what I need.
I had just missed the bus.

grammar.title: the only + noun (adjective)
grammar.explanation_ar: only كصفة: the only woman / the only person / the only choice = الوحيد، لا يوجد غيره.
grammar.explanation_en: "Only" as an adjective: the only person / the only choice = the one; there's no other.
examples: It was the only choice she could make.
It's the only place I like to eat.

grammar.title: More meanings of just: barely, really
grammar.explanation_ar: just enough = بالكاد يكفي. That's just silly = سخيف حقًا (بمعنى really / absolutely) وتتغير نبرة الصوت.
grammar.explanation_en: "Just enough" = barely enough. "That's just silly" = really / absolutely silly (said with a strong tone).
examples: I have just enough money to go.

questions.question: "This is the ___ time you can come."
questions.explanation_ar: صفة قبل اسم بمعنى الوحيد: the only.
questions.explanation_en: Adjective before a noun meaning the one: the only.
